text:
Alex Kim: quick sync 1 - how should Console surface automatic fallback triggers for rollouts? thinking an "evidence panel" that sits behind a compact card.

Nora Patel: compact by default, expandable evidence panel. show friendly reason + sampled counts. avoid dumping raw payloads. :white_check_mark:

Chris Wang: agree. minimal row: [mode] [short reason] [last_seen] [sampled X/Y]. clicking the row opens the panel with sampled events.

Priya Rao: operators want both the computed reason and the raw bucketed codes. e.g. computed_reason: "high_503_rate" with raw_reasons: {503: 112, timeout: 31}.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: r-20260401-07 triggered auto-fallback -> mode: soft_degrade, computed_reason: high_503_rate, sampled: 8/800, operator: Chris W

Alex Kim: privacy note: redact bodies, show stable event hash, path, status. "view raw" should be IAM-gated.

Nora Patel: UX affordance: a small "why" pill that on hover shows a mini-breakdown and a link to open full evidence panel. include retention and sampling tooltip.

Chris Wang: API proposal for /rollouts/:id/audit: return summary object (computed_reason, raw_reasons[], sampled_fraction, sampling_meta:{policy_id,seed}, sampled_event_ids[]). keep sampled_event_ids pointers, not full events.

Priya Rao: storage tradeoff: compute summary at write-time and store counts + sampled pointers for 30d. avoids scanning raw logs on read.

Alex Kim: can we include a stable deterministic sample id scheme so linking works across services?

Chris Wang: yes. sampling_meta.seed + deterministic hash(event) -> evt_id. We'll document it.

Nora Patel: microcopy: "Switched to fallback due to elevated 503 errors. 1% of requests sampled." short and human.

Alex Kim: checklist for RFC: redaction rules, retention=30d for sampled details, IAM gating for full view, sampling contract, compute-on-write summary.

Priya Rao: also add a small telemetry legend in the panel: explains sampled_fraction semantics (random uniform sampling, seed).

Chris Wang: I'll spin up a draft PR with schema + unit tests for redaction and sampling ids.

Nora Patel: I'll mock compact card + evidence panel in Figma and attach to RFC.

Alex Kim: Next steps: @Chris draft PR, @Nora attach mocks, @Priya add storage cost estimate. Filing the tiny RFC now. Thanks all :party_parrot:
